slides.title: Pim sorts the post
slides.text: Pim the owl sorts the morning post at the Netville post office. Every message must reach the right house, safe and whole.
slides.alt: Pim opens the Netville map: houses, roads and the first message waiting to be delivered.

focus.cue: A photo waits at Pim's Post, ready to travel
Its trip: across the roads to Grandma's House

slides.title: Too big for one envelope
slides.text: A photo is too big for one envelope. Pim cuts it into small numbered pieces called packets, so each piece can travel on its own.
slides.alt: Break It Up: a message too big for one trip is cut into small numbered packets at the post office.

focus.cue: One photo, three packets: each takes its own road
Packet 1 of 3: every packet wears its number

slides.title: Different roads
slides.text: Packets travel different roads through routers, which are other post offices along the way. If one road closes, a packet can take another road instead.
slides.alt: Many Roads: the town map offers more than one road between the same houses, and a closed road is not the end.

focus.cue: Packets travel the roads from office to office
If a road closes, another road can carry them

slides.title: Back together again
slides.text: Packets can arrive mixed up at the far end. Their numbers show the right order, so the far end can rebuild the whole photo.
slides.alt: Packets are on the roads of Netville, each carrying its number, so the far end can rebuild the message in order.

focus.cue: Packets can arrive mixed up at the far end
Their numbers show the right order
Put back together, the photo is whole again

slides.title: Hands that could peek
slides.text: Every hand that carries a packet could peek inside it. That is why later steps teach seals and locks to keep messages private.
slides.alt: Five packets for the zoo: every road on this map meets at the center office, where many hands can carry them.

focus.cue: Every road here meets at the center office
Many hands carry each packet on its way

words.means: a small numbered piece of a message
computers joined by roads, so they can send messages
a post office that passes packets along
put the pieces back together in order

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Packet Post at Break It Up, then play 2 levels of Many Roads. Watch the number on every packet.
slides.alt: Pim opens the Netville map: houses, roads and the first message waiting to be delivered.

focus.cue: Play Break It Up: watch the number on every packet
